# Pivot Plugin

> Pivot replaces BOTH rows (`processRows`) and columns (`processColumns`). Plugin system (hooks, priorities, queries) → grid-plugins.md · PinnedColumns → grid-plugin-pinned-columns.md · MultiSort, Filtering, row-identity rule → grid-plugins-catalog-data.md · `interleaveHiddenColumns`, column pipeline → grid-core.md.
>
> Read order for "pivot column lost state across a COLUMNS pass": #610/#609/#613 INVARIANT → #605 DECIDED. For "empty/extra column in pivot mode": #616 DECIDED. For "sticky pin wrong on pivot rows": PR #617 INVARIANT. For "grand-total footer not sticky / background cut off": #634 INVARIANT.

OWNS: pivot result, flattened pivot rows, expanded keys, column totals, sort state. HOOKS: onHeaderClick(-10), processRows(100), orderColumns, processColumns. QUERIES: `sort:get-sort-config`, `columns:is-replaced`, `rows:is-generated-field`, `rows:generated-rows`. ASKS: `filter:get-predicate`. EVENTS: `pivot-toggle`, `pivot-config-change`.

- INVARIANT: `PivotRow.isGroup` means "has sub-groups" (`remainingFields.length > 0`), NOT "is a group row". A single `rowGroupFields` yields `isGroup: false`; `getAllGroupKeys()` returns nothing.
- INVARIANT (generated field selectors): Pivot keys can contain `"`, `\`, or line breaks; runtime selectors interpolating a field into `[data-field="…"]` MUST use `plugins/shared/data-field-selector.ts`. Tests: `shared/data-field-selector.spec.ts` and quoted-key regressions in ReorderColumns, GroupingColumns, Visibility, and Clipboard.
- DECIDED (#605): layout changes (`refresh()` → row/column/value setters, panel edits, `enablePivot`/`disablePivot`) call `requestColumnsRender()`; a COLUMNS flush runs `processRows` BEFORE `processColumns`. Row updates (#608): `processRows` requests COLUMNS when `columnKeys` differ from `renderedColumnKeys` (set by `processColumns`, `null` while inactive); the scheduler absorbs it into the same flush. Same keys and header-click sort stay ROWS-only. Source restore lives in `orderColumns` (full list incl. hidden): no `__pivotLabel` ⇒ cache as `sourceColumns`; pivot output while `!(isActive && pivotResult)` ⇒ return the cache (covers invalid config); pivot passes re-adopt cached source objects by field (`applyState` clones). WHY not `processColumns`: its visible-only input loses hidden positions, and a hidden `__pivotLabel` fools it. Tests: `integration/pivot-runtime-layout.spec.ts`.
- DECIDED (#622): pivot-output filters apply post-aggregation via queries (no cross-plugin import). `rows:is-generated-field` is true only for `isPivotField` absent from configured fields and readable source-row properties; refresh configured ownership in `processConfig` before row processing (not from mutable effective columns, which can contain Pivot output). Source lookup follows `readCellField` literal-dotted and nested-path semantics; per-field ownership (hits AND misses) caches by `sourceRows` identity (inserts/removes replace the array) and invalidates on `cell-change` + `cell-edit-committed`/`-reverted` (editor writes skip `cell-change`) + `refresh()`, so a generated field scans rows once, not per Filtering query (PR #636: uncached misses cost 6 full scans per filter pass); lookups use property presence (`in`) to recognize inherited getters and non-enumerable fields. RULED OUT (PR #636 review): resolving ownership against ServerSide's loaded rows (`sourceRows` stays empty in `filterMode: 'local'`) — ServerSide is `incompatibleWith` Pivot, which needs the full dataset. Ownership is resolved before the first `orderColumns` and while Pivot is OFF, so undisplayed source fields filter normally and output filters stay dormant. Filtering skips generated fields; `filterPivotTree` asks `filter:get-predicate` for CURRENT output fields only (`__pivotTotal` only when `showTotals`), then `pivot-engine.ts#filterPivotRows` keeps matches and ancestors without mutating `pivotResult`. Filter-panel values come from `rows:generated-rows` (all nodes, ignoring expansion); generated `in` complements recompute on every panel open after Pivot rebuilds rows. WHY: Pivot (100) runs after Filtering, and source rows have no `k|field`. Async `filterHandler` returns no predicate; it owns every filter. RULED OUT: Filtering declaring `pivot` (mutual queries) — optional deps also order `features` (`registry.ts#orderPluginsByDependencies`), so a two-way edge cycles and reverses config order; only Pivot declares `filtering`. Totals (group, grand, `percentOf*`) stay unfiltered: pivot-column filters only hide rows. Tests: `integration/pivot-filtering.spec.ts`.
- INVARIANT (PR #610, #609, #613): `processColumns` regenerates EVERY pivot column; `carryRuntimeState` carries BY FIELD (input + `hiddenPivotColumns`): `__originalWidth` (default; merge() never sees pivot columns), `width`/`__renderedWidth`/`__userResized` (when `__renderedWidth` is set), `hidden` (`orderColumns` pulls hidden NON-source fields into `hiddenPivotColumns`, because `interleaveHiddenColumns` skips fields already output; also drops stale keys), and `pinned`, then re-applies `pin-order.ts#reorderColumnsForPinning`, since regeneration restores pivot order. RULED OUT (#613, #616): any non-zero Pivot `processColumns` priority; it reorders Pivot against every other (incl. third-party) `processColumns`.
- DECIDED (#616): utility columns are OMITTED while pivoting, in either registration order. Pivot answers `columns:is-replaced` (`isActive && pivotResult`); MasterDetail and RowDragDrop `queryBoolean` it in `processColumns` and skip their column. Selection (-20) runs before Pivot, so regeneration drops it. WHY: a column added after Pivot's regeneration is an empty cell, because `renderRow` draws no expander/handle. A new utility-column plugin MUST check the query too, and declare `{ name: 'pivot', required: false }` (`grid-architecture.instructions.md` → Query System Contracts). Tests: `pivot-runtime-layout.spec.ts › utility columns`. Selection's checkbox column carries `pinned: 'left'` without PinnedColumns; it no longer blocks re-pivoting since `utility: true` columns skip plugin-property validation (#626, grid-features.md § validator).
- INVARIANT (PR #617): pivot rows are custom `renderRow` rows, so they get no `afterCellRender`. Sticky pins need (1) `pivot-rows.ts#createPivotCell`, which sets `data-field` so Pinned's `applyStickyOffsets` styles the body and the grand-total footer; and (2) `renderRow` → `applyPinnedOffsets`, which replays `resolvePinPlan` (field → offset for the CURRENT side only; a style read only for `start`/`end`) on recreated cells. Current side only, because Pinned's maps keep unpinned fields and hold the OLD side after a switch until the next re-measure. The plan is keyed on `visibleColumns` identity and dropped on `PINNED_OFFSETS_CHANGE`, in `processRows` (runs before rows on ROWS+ flushes; a direction change keeps the column array), and in `afterRender`. Any stale replay that remains, e.g. on a VIRTUALIZATION-only flush, is corrected by Pinned's next measure, because `applyCellStickyOffset` is EXCLUSIVE: it clears the opposite class and inset. WHY: one query per change, not per row; unpinned grids only pay an identity check. Tests: `pivot-runtime-layout.spec.ts › pinned pivot columns`.
- INVARIANT (#634): `renderPivotGrandTotalRow` ASSIGNS `className` (shared by in-row-model + footer paths), so `renderGrandTotalFooter` MUST re-add `pivot-grand-total-footer` after EVERY render. That class supplies `position: sticky` + `z-index` + `min-width: fit-content`; `.tbw-scroll-area` scrolls only horizontally (vertical is faux), so without it the footer is viewport-wide — background stops and pinned footer cells scroll away. happy-dom has no layout: tests assert the class (`pivot-runtime-layout.spec.ts`).
- DECIDED (Aug 2026, duplicate value fields + streaming): pivot value identity is `columnKey|field` for unique fields and adds `|aggFunc` (then config index for repeated identical aggregators) only when the field repeats. WHY: `PivotValueField` permits the same source field with multiple aggregators; field-only keys silently overwrote earlier results. Built-ins stream filtered numbers without arrays; repeated built-ins for one field share one row scan. Custom functions retain separate collected arrays. Owners: `pivot-model.ts#createValueKeys`, `pivot-engine.ts#aggregateValueFields`. Tests/bench: `pivot.spec.ts`, `pivot-engine.bench.ts`.
- DECIDED (#449, SC 2.5.7): plain `click` on a field chip opens `plugins/shared/drag-alternative-menu`. (a) `role`/`aria-label`/`tabindex=-1` sit on `.tbw-pivot-chip-label`, NOT the chip (the chip holds `.tbw-pivot-chip-remove`); available-field chips are childless so the role sits on the chip. (b) `chipMenu` is a MODULE-LEVEL singleton: `refreshPanel()` does `innerHTML=''` + re-render without cleanup, so a per-chip menu would be torn out mid-click; `menu.open()` re-parents to the anchor's grid host ⇒ safe across grids; `renderPivotPanel` cleanup disposes+nulls it. (c) `onReorderFieldInZone` takes an INSERT-BEFORE index in the pre-move list ⇒ up = `index-1`, down = `index+2`. Owner: `pivot-panel.ts`. Tests: `pivot-panel.spec.ts` › "click-only chip menu (SC 2.5.7)".
